summary: Backend-only testing for Oyun Loncası Yönetim API. Wrote pytest suite covering all 18 endpoints/behaviors from the review request. All 18 tests PASSED (100%). Verified stats, member CRUD + 156-member seed w/ rank dist (GOW=94/R5=1/R4=8/R3=20/R2=18/R1=15), member search, events active(6)/archived(8), event CRUD + archive-group, points list (enriched with member/event names), single & bulk point creation, leaderboard sorted with positions + group filter, member history, commanders list/filter/CRUD, CSV export (Turkish headers), event-groups aggregation, and multiplier-history.

minor.issue: create_point calls enrich_point twice unnecessarily (once on unused p.model_dump(), once on doc). Harmless but wasted DB roundtrip.
Does not validate empty update body (unlike members/events which raise 400 on 'Değişiklik yok'). Inconsistent.
group_name is a query param instead of body; acceptable but consider POST body for consistency.
Search is applied AFTER limit-truncated fetch, so search may miss records beyond first 1000.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 651 lines - close to the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (members, events, points, commanders, stats) as feature set grows.

enrich_point is called on every point on every list request (N+1 lookups). For 100k+ points this will be slow. Consider batching or storing denormalized member/event names at write time (already partially done in seed).
Seed uses random values on startup, making tests that assert total_points values non-deterministic. Not an issue currently since we only assert counts, but flag for future.
No pagination on /api/members, /api/points, /api/leaderboard - hardcoded to_list(1000/100000). Fine for now but should paginate.
commander PATCH allows empty updates silently (bug/inconsistency vs member/event PATCH).
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec; browsers will reject. If credentials aren't actually needed, set allow_credentials=False; otherwise restrict origins.
test_credentials: None required - no auth on API.
seed_data_creation: None - relied on auto-seed on backend startup (156 members, 14 events, 14 commanders, ~1120 point records). All test-created data (TEST_ prefixed) is cleaned up in each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend not tested per request. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in <3s and is safe to re-run. If DB gets wiped, POST /api/seed will re-populate (or restart backend for auto-seed). Public URL: https://oyun-loncasi.preview.emergentagent.com/api
